overview: The committee approved monthly invoices and minutes before receiving an update on the project schedule and MSBA funding regulations. Discussion focused on the transition to the Preferred Schematic Report phase and the specific cost caps for state reimbursement.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the minutes from the March 23 meeting.

items.title: Approval of Invoices
items.summary: Approved March invoices totaling $281,206.66 for project management, design, and environmental consulting services.

items.title: Project Schedule Update
items.summary: The project team outlined the timeline for the feasibility study, with a target date of June 10 for the committee to select a preferred design option.

items.title: MSBA Eligible and Ineligible Costs
items.summary: The committee reviewed MSBA reimbursement limits, including a building cost cap of $605 per square foot and the total ineligibility of costs related to asbestos abatement and swimming pools.

items.title: Funding Approval Process and 3011 Form
items.summary: The project team explained the Project Funding Agreement process and presented the MSBA budget template used to determine the final grant amount.

items.title: Upcoming Meetings and Design Refinement
items.summary: The committee reviewed the schedule for upcoming community forums and a deadline for building program reduction proposals on April 27.

subject: High School Building Project Schedule and Funding
